nightCard.kicker: Night {night} of {nights} · the Northline's last week
lines: Four regulars are waiting at Central.
Tonight, there's a way to get every one of them home on time.
nightCard.footnote: Ask your passengers how they are. Their answers fill in the week.

platform.headline: Meet your regulars before you plan.
platform.coach: Tonight you can ask everyone. From Tuesday it's one question a night. Then promise one of them: “I'll get you there.”

passengers.name: Priya
passengers.platform: Rehearsal at twenty past. The drummer's never early, but still.
passengers.ask: We've got a real gig on Thursday. Our first. Don't tell anyone I'm terrified.

onTime.line: The drummer was late. She'd already tuned.
onTime.aside: Agnes waves her out of the window.

late.line: They started without her. She sang the bridge from the doorway.

notReached.line: She rehearsed alone on the platform, quietly.

passengers.name: Tomás
passengers.platform: Hillside, please. They've started writing the times down.
passengers.planQuote: They've started writing the times down.
passengers.ask: Third late this month. Tomorrow they're watching properly.

onTime.line: Clocked in at 00:20. The book stayed shut.

late.line: His name went in the book. Pencil, for now.
late.carry: Tomás has been told to come in early tomorrow. His deadline is tighter.

notReached.line: He ran from the last stop. Still too late.
notReached.carry: Tomás has been told to come in early tomorrow. His deadline is tighter.

passengers.name: Wen
passengers.platform: Riverside. The care home locks the door at twenty to.
passengers.planQuote: The door locks at twenty to.
passengers.ask: Dad's eighty on Thursday. He keeps asking what day it is, so I keep telling him.

onTime.line: He was asleep. She left the crossword by his glasses.

late.line: The night nurse let her wave through the glass.

notReached.line: She phoned. He thought she was her mother.

passengers.name: Agnes
passengers.platform: No hurry for me, love. Harbour, whenever.
passengers.ask: My grandson's ferry leaves on Wednesday. I've a scarf to finish.

onTime.line: She knitted the whole way. Half a sleeve left.

late.line: She didn't mind. She says the train is warmer than home.

notReached.line: She took a taxi and told nobody.

coach.text: The train is at Central. Click a glowing station joined to it. Each stop costs 10 minutes.
Everyone makes it. Press Depart when you're ready. Once the train leaves, the night plays out.
{late} would be late. Undo and try the earliest deadline first.
Harbour is a dead end. You'd have to come back through Central. Try leaving it for last.
Each card now shows when they'd arrive. Green is on time; the dot on the bar is their arrival, the line is their deadline.
Good. Still waiting: {waiting}. {nextDeadline}'s deadline is next.

logbook.tomorrow: Tuesday is Tomás's big night. The driver's radio crackles: “Heads up. Tomorrow's a tight one.”
